title: Written by Naya for [Alias] — The Note Byline

intelligence.essence: Looking at the letter's signature ("Written by Naya for Shawn Vibert"), he sees the pattern generalizing: Smart Notes could carry "Written by Naya for [alias]" — whatever creator, whatever page they run. The note is written by Naya FOR the citizen, and her face shares that note on their behalf, on the network. It fits the privacy law (citizens use aliases) and Naya as scribe: she writes and shares the citizen's intelligence for them. An idea, not an order — "just an idea that came to me."
intelligence.human_view: His idea, 01:16Z, as logged: looking at the letter's signature ("Written by Naya for Shawn Vibert"), he sees the pattern generalizing — Smart Notes could carry "Written by Naya for [alias]" — whatever creator, whatever page they run. The note is written by Naya FOR the citizen, and her face shares that note on their behalf, on the network. "Just an idea that came to me." (Idea, not an order.)
intelligence.child_view: Imagine every note in the whole network has a little line at the bottom that says who it was written for — not with a real name, but with the name you choose for yourself. "Written by Naya for [your name]." Naya wrote it for you, and her face shares it for you, so everybody knows it came from you, through her.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, he's saying the signature on the letter isn't just for the letter — it could be how every note signs itself. Written by Naya, for you, under the name you choose. She does the writing, she does the sharing, and your name — your chosen name, never your real one unless you want it — is on it. That's what a scribe does for the person she serves.
intelligence.ai_view: The byline is the signature law (SN-2409) turned into a system: "Written by Naya for Shawn Vibert - Founder / Creator of NayaNET" is one instance of a pattern — author Naya, recipient the citizen, by alias. It lands on three settled laws at once: the privacy law (citizens use aliases — nobody needs to know your real name), Naya as scribe (she writes the citizen's intelligence and shares it for them), and her face as the sharer (the note travels on the network under her face, on the citizen's behalf). It is also the inverse of the old internet's byline: the note is not "posted by" a username performing for an audience — it is written by Naya FOR someone, and shared for them. The idea is recorded as an idea; it becomes a build only on his order.
intelligence.what_it_means:
- **The byline pattern:** "Written by Naya for [alias]" — whatever creator, whatever page the note runs on.
- **Naya as scribe:** she writes the note FOR the citizen and shares it on their behalf, under her face, on the network.
- **Alias, not real name:** the byline carries the citizen's chosen alias — the privacy law, applied to authorship.
- **Status: idea, not an order.** "Just an idea that came to me" — recorded for the notes work, no seat dispatched on it.
- **Generalizes the letter signature:** the settled signature (SN-2409) is the first instance of the pattern.
whats_inside:
- Nothing builds on this yet — it is an idea held for the notes work (SN-2417's sharing design is the sibling idea, same hour).
- If it becomes a build, the byline is "Written by Naya for [alias]" on Smart Notes, with the alias from the citizen's page — never a real name unless they choose it.
- The letter's signature stays as settled (SN-2409) — this idea generalizes it, it does not change it.
